summary: Frontend-only mobile verification of monthly calendar labels (category/subcategory mapping, status colors, navigation behavior) completed on owner workspace via read-only JWT; no DB write operations performed.

ui_bugs.component: Month grid day cell interactions (August 8 with two events)
ui_bugs.issue: Repeatedly tapping day cell/day-number area opened an event detail instead of opening the two-event picker modal. Picker did not appear in 3 attempts.

integration_issues.issue: Event-label pressables inside a day cell appear to intercept taps; day-level behavior (1 event direct open, 2+ picker) is unreliable when labels are present.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error persists when opening event detail from calendar: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.'

action_items: Fix day-cell click handling for multi-event days so tapping day 8 (not label) consistently opens calendar-day-picker with two rows.
Ensure day-level Pressable receives intended taps when child event labels exist (review stopPropagation/target area layering in month cell).
Fix raw text node rendering under <View> in event/[id] path to remove RN runtime error.
Optional parity fix: in calendarEventLabel(), for 'warsztaty/*' return concrete subcategory only (without forced 'Warsztaty ' prefix) to match strict requirement wording.
critical_code_review_comments: kalendarz.tsx implements 2 labels + hidden count (+N więcej) correctly in source, but dataset in Aug 2026 has max 2 events/day so +N was not observable in UI.
calendarEvent.ts maps labels from category hierarchy (no AI/description dependency), and fallback for empty category is 'Bez kategorii' as required.
Day click logic is centralized in handleDayPress, but nested label pressables can dominate hit areas in dense cells, producing inconsistent day-click outcomes.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. No MongoDB create/update/delete actions executed during this run.

post_fix_verification.day_picker: PASS — dedicated cal-day-number-{day} opens picker; August 8 shows exactly 2 rows
post_fix_verification.event_label_navigation: PASS — clicking Konie label opens the exact event detail
post_fix_verification.react_native_console: PASS — removed empty-string child from client discount condition; no Unexpected text node after calendar-to-event navigation
post_fix_verification.database: PASS — calendar implementation is frontend-only and performs no MongoDB writes
post_fix_verification.source_of_label: PASS — category/subcategory only; no event name, notes, description or AI

context_for_next_testing_agent: Loop-prevention stop applied for day-8 picker after 3 failed attempts (generic click, targeted retry, coordinate day-number click). Verified pass items: label text mapping in August (Tematyczne/Standard/Konie/Firmowa/Okolicznościowa), Bez kategorii fallback visible, potwierdzona blue in legend and label, truncation+no overflow, label click opens exact event, single-event day opens directly, empty-day preserves add flow.
rca_of_issue: Likely RCA for day-8 issue: month cell contains nested pressables for event labels with stopPropagation and dense vertical stacking; practical tap targets in web preview route user taps to event labels, bypassing day-level handleDayPress path that should open day picker for 2+ events. Repro: open August 2026 month view -> tap day 8 cell/day-number region -> event detail opens, calendar-day-picker not shown. Mitigation: reserve dedicated tappable day-number/header zone with its own Pressable/testID and/or adjust pointerEvents/z-index so day-level tap is deterministic.
